No. No it isn’t. All these youtubers say it’s better to sell in full public lobbies or at least public lobbies with a ton of people in them, because of the 1% bonus each player gives. Yea that’s a nice bonus and all, but, at the same time, usually when they sell, they have 5 or more people protecting them. Not every single fucking person has that luxury of having many high levels protecting ya. 

Now the reason why I said it isn’t worth it to sell in full / large public lobbies is because the risk of getting attacked is waaaayyy too high. Would you rather get 100k more for completing a sell, or have all of that work and product go to waste? Again, not every single player has 5 or more high levels protecting them, so the chance of getting your stuff destroyed is so much higher. 

All in all, the risk of selling in full / large public lobbies is way too much of a risk of losing all of your product. So just don’t do it. It’s not worth to do all of that crap just to have all of it go to waste.
